intended_object: The canonical inclusion prefunctor from a quiver V into (the underlying quiver of) the free groupoid on V. It is the unit of the free-groupoid/forgetful adjunction: each vertex goes to itself and each arrow to its class in the free groupoid. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The free groupoid is built as the path category of Symmetrify V, quotiented by the congruence generated by 𝟙 X ~ f ≫ reverse f, for arrows f of the symmetrified quiver. `of` sends a vertex X to ⟨X⟩ and an arrow f to the class of the one-step path along the forward copy of f. The lemma `of_eq` shows this equals the composite Symmetrify.of ⋙ Paths.of ⋙ Quotient.functor, which is exactly the standard inclusion. It is stated for an arbitrary quiver, so the generality is the natural one. This is Mathlib's own definition of the notion, so no other declaration duplicates it.
